_comment: Alert wording, per language and - where it actually differs - per finance mode. The API stores the KEY and the values in a notification's meta, never the rendered sentence, so an alert raised last month reads in whatever language the person is using today. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from the stored values; a category name is filled in already-translated, and anything the person typed themselves (a goal title, an expense description) is passed through untouched.

message.en: You have spent {spent} against a {limit} limit for {category} this month. That is {percent}% of the limit.
message.roman_ur: Is mahine {category} par {spent} kharch ho chuke hain jab ke had {limit} thi. Yeh had ka {percent}% hai.

message.en: Only {remaining} left in your {category} budget this month. Slow down a little to stay inside it.
message.roman_ur: Is mahine {category} ke budget mein sirf {remaining} baqi hain. Thora ehtiyat karein taa-ke had ke andar rahein.

message.en: The deadline for "{title}" has passed and {remaining} is still short. Push the deadline out or top it up.
message.roman_ur: "{title}" ki aakhri tareekh guzar chuki hai aur {remaining} abhi kam hain. Tareekh aagay barhayein ya raqam poori karein.

message.en: You still need {remaining} for "{title}". That is about {perDay} a day.
message.roman_ur: "{title}" ke liye abhi {remaining} chahiye. Yani taqreeban {perDay} rozana.

student.en: Nothing logged for two days. Add today's spends while you still remember them, even the small ones.
student.roman_ur: Do din se kuch darj nahi hua. Aaj ke kharchay abhi likh lein jab tak yaad hain, chhote wale bhi.

householder.en: Nothing logged for two days. Add what the household spent while you still remember it, the small things included.
householder.roman_ur: Do din se kuch darj nahi hua. Ghar ke kharchay abhi likh lein jab tak yaad hain, chhoti cheezein bhi.

student.en: {what} of {amount} is due on {date}. Keep that aside.
student.roman_ur: {what} ({amount}) {date} ko dena hai. Itni raqam alag rakh lein.

householder.en: {what} of {amount} is due on {date}. Set that aside before the rest of the month goes.
householder.roman_ur: {what} ({amount}) {date} ko dena hai. Baqi mahina kharch hone se pehle yeh alag rakh lein.

message.en: You saved the full {amount}. That is real discipline. Time to set the next one!
message.roman_ur: Aapne poore {amount} bacha liye. Yeh asli pabandi hai. Ab agla maqsad rakhein!

message.en: You paid {person} back - {amount} is square. Nice.
message.roman_ur: Aapne {person} ko {amount} wapas kar diye - hisab saaf. Bohat khoob.

message.en: You got your {amount} back from {person}. Nice.
message.roman_ur: {person} se aapke {amount} wapas mil gaye. Bohat khoob.
